svg.title: Development philosophy
svg.desc: Performance first: Event-driven code, cached natives, ox_target and zones over polling loops. The server decides: Every price, rank and balance is checked server-side. Clients only ask. Modular resources: Small resources, clean exports: one skills core feeds eight skills. Maintainable architecture: Config-driven and documented, with SQL migrations and audits in-repo. Polished interfaces: One design system for every NUI: two themes and controller support. Diagram: player input passes through the client to server validation, then oxmysql, then synced state.
